```plato

    //==
    // # Planar-polygon kernels in space
    //
    // The SPACE analogues of the 2D ring kernels in `geometry.library.plato`:
    // Newell's vector area, a stable in-plane projection basis, the projected even-odd
    // containment test, the fan-decomposition centroid of a planar ring, and the bodily
    // translation of a box. Every polygon body that works in 3D is written in terms of
    // these, and `TranslateBounds` additionally serves the swept-solid bounds in
    // `spatial-primitives.library.plato`.

    //==
    // # Planar-polygon kernels in space

    // The vector area of a closed ring: (1/2) * sum of Pi x Pi+1 over the position
    // vectors. Its magnitude is the enclosed area and its direction is the
    // right-hand-rule normal, both independent of where the origin sits (the
    // origin-dependent terms cancel around a closed loop). Newell's method.
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Polygon#Area
    VectorArea(points: Array<Point3D>): Vector3D
        => points.Count
            .MapRange(i => points[i].PositionVector.Cross(points.AtModulo(i + 1).PositionVector))
            .Reduce(Vector3D.Zero, (acc, c) => acc + c)
            * 0.5;
```
